10	class IntakeDatingRuleTest {
11	
12	    private fun dating(
13	        lmp: String? = "2026-02-01",
14	        uss: String? = null,
15	        method: String? = "LMP",
16	        transfer: String? = null,
17	        embryo: Int? = null,
18	    ) = DemoPatientDating(
19	        patientId = "p1", lmpDate = lmp, ultrasoundEdd = uss, agreedEdd = null,
20	        datingMethod = method, notes = null, transferDate = transfer, embryoAgeDays = embryo,
21	    )
22	
23	    private fun lmpValues(lmp: String?) = PatientDraftValues(lmpDate = lmp.orEmpty())
24	
25	    private fun lmpDating(lmp: String, edd: String) =
26	        IntakeDating(lmp, edd, note = "Baseline from intake LMP ($lmp)")
27	
28	    private fun ivfValues(transfer: String = "2026-03-01", embryo: String = "5") =
29	        PatientDraftValues(datingMethod = "IVF_TRANSFER", transferDate = transfer, embryoAgeDays = embryo)
30	
31	    private fun scanValues(date: String = "2026-03-01", weeks: String = "8", days: String = "3") =
32	        PatientDraftValues(datingMethod = "Ultrasound", scanDate = date, scanGaWeeks = weeks, scanGaDays = days)
33	
34	    private fun clinicalValues(edd: String = "2026-11-20") =
35	        PatientDraftValues(datingMethod = "Clinical", agreedEdd = edd)
36	
37	    // ---- spec examples ----
38	    @Test fun noExisting_validDraft() =
39	        assertEquals(lmpDating("2026-02-01", "2026-11-08"), intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues("2026-02-01")))
40	
41	    @Test fun noExisting_paddedDraft() =
42	        assertEquals(lmpDating("2026-02-01", "2026-11-08"), intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues("  2026-02-01 ")))
43	
44	    @Test fun noExisting_invalidFormat() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues("01/02/2026")))
45	    @Test fun noExisting_emptyDraft() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues("")))
46	    @Test fun noExisting_nullDraft() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues(null)))
47	
48	    @Test fun sameLmp_null() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(dating(), lmpValues("2026-02-01")))
49	
50	    @Test fun lmpOnlyChanged_updates() =

52	
53	    @Test fun existingUltrasoundEdd_null() =
54	        assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(dating(uss = "2026-11-12"), lmpValues("2026-02-08")))
55	
56	    @Test fun ivfDating_null() =
57	        assertNull(
58	            intakeDatingUpdate(
59	                dating(lmp = null, method = "IVF", transfer = "2026-02-15", embryo = 5),
60	                lmpValues("2026-02-01"),
61	            ),
62	        )
63	
64	    @Test fun ultrasoundMethodWithoutEdd_null() =
65	        assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(dating(method = "Ultrasound", uss = null), lmpValues("2026-02-08")))
66	
67	    @Test fun nullMethodCountsAsLmp() =
68	        assertEquals(
69	            lmpDating("2026-02-08", "2026-11-15"),
70	            intakeDatingUpdate(dating(method = null), lmpValues("2026-02-08")),
71	        )
72	
73	    // ---- own boundaries ----
74	    @Test fun leapYear_plus280() =
75	        assertEquals(lmpDating("2028-02-29", "2028-12-05"), intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues("2028-02-29")))
76	
77	    @Test fun whitespaceUltrasoundEdd_treatedAsMissing() =
78	        assertEquals(
79	            lmpDating("2026-02-08", "2026-11-15"),
80	            intakeDatingUpdate(dating(uss = "   "), lmpValues("2026-02-08")),

83	    @Test fun lowercaseLmpMethod_isLmp() =
84	        assertEquals(
85	            lmpDating("2026-02-08", "2026-11-15"),

89	    @Test fun impossibleDate_null() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, lmpValues("2026-02-30")))

92	        assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(dating(lmp = " 2026-02-01 "), lmpValues("2026-02-01")))

94	    // ---- round 4g: dating choice ----
95	    @Test fun lmpResultCarriesMethodAndNote() {

117	        assertEquals(
118	            IntakeDating(
119	                lmpDate = null, agreedEdd = "2026-11-17", datingMethod = "IVF_TRANSFER",
120	                transferDate = "2026-03-01", embryoAgeDays = 5,
121	                note = "Baseline from intake IVF transfer (2026-03-01, day 5)",
122	            ),

135	                note = "Baseline from intake scan (2026-03-01, 8w3d)",

140	    @Test fun scan_badGaDays_null() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, scanValues(days = "7")))

148	            IntakeDating(

150	                note = "Baseline from intake due date (2026-11-20)",
151	            ),
152	            intakeDatingUpdate(null, clinicalValues()),
153	        )
154	
155	    @Test fun clinical_badDate_null() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, clinicalValues("20/11/2026")))
156	    @Test fun clinical_blankDate_null() = assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(null, clinicalValues("")))

158	    @Test fun existingPatient_nonLmpMethods_null() {
159	        val existing = dating()
160	        assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(existing, ivfValues()))
161	        assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(existing, scanValues()))
162	        assertNull(intakeDatingUpdate(existing, clinicalValues()))
163	    }

1	package com.sherifradwan.ancnative.state
2	
3	import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.DemoPatientDating
4	import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.eddFromLmp
5	import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull
6	
7	internal data class IntakeDating(val lmpDate: String, val agreedEdd: String)
8	
9	internal fun intakeDatingUpdate(existing: DemoPatientDating?, draftLmp: String?): IntakeDating? {
10	    val lmp = draftLmp?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) ?: return null
11	    val parsedLmp = parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull(lmp) ?: return null
12	
13	    if (existing != null) {
14	        if (existing.lmpDate?.trim() == lmp) return null
15	        if (!existing.ultrasoundEdd.isNullOrBlank() ||
16	            existing.transferDate != null ||
17	            existing.embryoAgeDays != null ||
18	            existing.datingMethod != null && !existing.datingMethod.equals("LMP", ignoreCase = true)
19	        ) return null
20	    }
21	
22	    return IntakeDating(lmp, eddFromLmp(parsedLmp).toString())
23	}
24	
25	internal fun profileSavedNotice(datingAttempted: Boolean, datingSaved: Boolean): SavedNotice =
26	    if (datingAttempted && !datingSaved) SavedNotice.PATIENT_DATING_NOT_UPDATED else SavedNotice.PATIENT
